privacy.s1_text: We, QODEVS Teknoloji Tic. ve San. LTD ŞTİ, take the protection of your personal data very seriously. This privacy policy explains how we collect, process, and use your personal data when you visit our website www.qodevs.com.
privacy.s2_text: The entity responsible for data processing is:
privacy.s3_title: 3. Collection and storage of personal data as well as the type and purpose of its use
privacy.s3_text: Our website primarily serves to provide information about our services. We do not collect any personal data unless you contact us via the contact form.
privacy.s4_text: When you contact us via the contact form on our website, the email address you enter will be used solely for processing your request. Your data will not be stored after your request has been processed.
privacy.s5_text: Our website uses Google Analytics, a web analytics service provided by Google Inc. ("Google"). Google Analytics uses cookies, which enable an analysis of website usage. The information generated by the cookie about your use of our website is generally transmitted to and stored on a Google server in the USA. This information is used to evaluate website usage and to compile reports on website activity. QODEVS does not store this data.
privacy.s6_text: As a user of our website, you have the right to request information about the data we have stored about you at any time. Since we do not store any personal data, we generally do not process requests regarding stored data.
privacy.s7_text: We reserve the right to amend this privacy policy at any time to ensure compliance with current legal requirements. The current privacy policy can be accessed at any time on our website at www.qodevs.com/privacy-policy.
